source_or_bom: Rust workspace: jcode v0.85.0-k1.0.0 (1jehuang/jcode fork by KooshaPari). Multi-crate Cargo workspace with TUI (ratatui), app-core, tool-core, provider adapters, MCP server, and CLI. 1,214 Rust source files. Edition 2024, nightly toolchain.
identity_method: Git HEAD commit SHA + Cargo.toml version + file count. Subject digest computed from subject.json value hash per PEP.
limitation: Assessment covers the fork as of the stated commit. Upstream changes after fork point are not independently verified. No deployed binary or runtime execution was measured; assessment is source-level.
